missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Поэт' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'написал'. 'Этот' is the agreeing masculine demonstrative, and 'много стихов' is a genitive-plural quantity phrase.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative equals genitive. 'Поэта' takes the -а ending because the noun is animate masculine, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Этого' agrees in the animate masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Поэта' is the genitive showing whose book it is. 'Известного' is the agreeing masculine genitive adjective. A core attribution pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative indirect object. 'Поэту' is the dative recipient of the letters. 'Письма' is the accusative-plural thing written, and 'читатели' is the nominative-plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Поэтом' is the instrumental after the preposition 'с', required by 'познакомиться'. 'Молодым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Поэте' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the topic of conversation. 'Любимом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Поэта' follows 'у' in the genitive to express possession. 'Необычный талант' is the nominative thing possessed, with 'был' agreeing in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Поэты' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'выступали'. 'Разные' agrees as a plural adjective, and 'на вечере' gives the prepositional location.

missions.phrase: Я люблю русских поэтов девятнадцатого века.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural equals genitive. 'Поэтов' takes the genitive-plural -ов ending, which serves as the accusative because the noun is animate. 'Русских' agrees in the plural.

missions.phrase: Он очень талантливый и тонкий поэт.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate noun. 'Поэт' is nominative as the predicate. 'Талантливый' and 'тонкий' are agreeing masculine adjectives describing his gift, joined by 'и'.
